author: PackRat 🐀
name: Performance Grapher
description: See stutter and hardware changes before they disappear. Keep live game FPS, low-frame stats, frametime, and optional HTTPS ping beside any sensors iCUE can read, or hide FPS to reclaim the display for up to 16 sensor readings. Give each sensor a graph, bar, radial gauge, or clean readout, set a durable custom scale, smooth its history, and personalize the title, font, colors, warnings, decimals, and background.
